fullPassage: Work stress has increased significantly over the past two decades, a development mostly driven by an intensification of psychological job demands. In a comparable trend, the psychological demands surrounding training and competition in sport have increased, and these demands will likely only increase further. Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is essential for individuals to achieve optimal health, well-being, and performance. In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse negative outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. Likewise, potential consequences of prolonged stress and chronic strain for athletes are underrecovery, overtraining syndrome, decreased performance, and ill-health.

questions.passage: Work stress has increased (A)[significantly / marginally] over the past two decades, a development mostly driven by an intensification of psychological job demands. In a comparable trend, the psychological demands surrounding training and competition in sport have increased, and these demands will likely only increase further. Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is (B)[essential / irrelevant] for individuals to achieve optimal health, well-being, and performance. In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse negative outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. Likewise, potential consequences of prolonged stress and chronic strain for athletes are underrecovery, overtraining syndrome, (C)[decreased / enhanced] performance, and ill-health.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ significantly — essential — decreased: 스트레스가 '상당히' 증가, 균형 유지가 '필수적', '감소한' 수행 능력.
❌ ① marginally — essential — decreased: '미미하게'는 원문과 반대.
❌ ② significantly — irrelevant — decreased: '무관한'은 essential의 반대.
❌ ④ significantly — essential — enhanced: '향상된'은 부정적 결과와 모순.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② intensification — delicate — insufficient: 심리적 요구의 '심화', '섬세한' 균형, '불충분한' 회복.
❌ ① reduction — delicate — insufficient: '감소'는 스트레스 증가와 모순.
❌ ③ intensification — rigid — insufficient: '경직된'은 delicate의 반대.
❌ ④ intensification — delicate — excessive: '과도한' 회복은 맥락상 부적절.

det.analysis:
✅ ④ comparable — essential — prolonged: '비슷한' 추세, 균형 유지가 '필수적', '장기적' 스트레스 반응.
❌ ① contrasting — essential — prolonged: '대조적인'은 유사한 추세와 반대.
❌ ② comparable — unnecessary — prolonged: '불필요한'은 필수적과 반대.
❌ ③ comparable — essential — brief: '짧은'은 장기적과 반대.

Maintaining the delicate balance between stress and recovery is essential for individuals to achieve ①<u>optimal</u> health, well-being, and performance. In contrast, insufficient recovery from the demands of work or sport can lead to prolonged stress reactions and chronic strain, which can ultimately lead to diverse ②<u>positive</u> outcomes. For example, employees are at risk of occupational burnout, lower productivity, a higher rate of sickness absence, and an earlier exit from the labour force. To reduce stress, many companies have introduced in-house yoga programs and flexible working hours for their employees. questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① optimal: '최적의' 건강 — 적절.
✅ ② positive: 원문은 negative(부정적인). 불충분한 회복은 '부정적인' 결과를 초래.
❌ ③ decreased: '감소한' 수행 능력 — 적절.
❌ ④ ill-health: '건강 악화' — 적절.
det.tip: negative outcomes(부정적 결과) ↔ positive outcomes(긍정적 결과).

det.analysis:
❌ ① delicate: '섬세한' 균형 — 적절.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 balance가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 균형 — (B) 잔액: (A)에서 balance는 스트레스와 회복 사이의 '균형', (B)에서는 은행 계좌의 '잔액'.
❌ ① (A) 잔액 — (B) 균형: 의미가 바뀜.
❌ ② (A) 균형 — (B) 저울: (B)는 계좌 맥락.
❌ ④ (A) 체중계 — (B) 잔액: (A)의 의미가 틀림.
det.tip: balance — 균형, 잔액, 저울. balance between A and B = A와 B 사이의 균형.
